business_problem: AutoScout24 Group needed to deliver product changes faster across growing engineering, data, and product complexity without compromising reliability for buyers, dealers, and customer-facing vehicle marketplaces.
solution_summary: AutoScout24 Group adopted a two-layer OpenAI rollout that paired broad access with deep workflow integration. ChatGPT was deployed across the company so roughly 2,000 employees could use AI in daily work and build baseline literacy across functions. In parallel, around 1,000 builder roles embedded Codex into engineering, data, and product processes after a three-month evaluation showed gains in usability, workflow fit, code quality, and productivity. Teams used Codex for automated pull-request reviews, large-scale refactoring, technical documentation, and post-incident analysis, while nontechnical staff used AI to prototype ideas and validate concepts faster. A cross-functional AI Champions network connected leadership with individual teams so adoption stayed grounded in practical use cases and existing workflows instead of isolated experimentation.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides organization-wide AI access so employees across functions can use AI in everyday work.

solution_components.name: Codex
solution_components.role: Acts as the coding agent embedded into engineering, data, and product workflows for reviews, refactoring, documentation, and incident follow-up.

data_flow: Employee questions and drafts flow through ChatGPT for general assistance, while code, pull requests, incident context, and documentation tasks move into Codex inside engineering workflows. Outputs are reviewed by teams and fed back through the AI Champions network to scale working patterns across the company.
business_outcome: AutoScout24 Group shortened selected development timelines from weeks to days, raised engineering throughput and code consistency, reduced manual review work, and expanded AI-driven experimentation across both technical and nontechnical teams.
metrics: Reduced development timelines from 2–3 weeks to 2–3 days for select projects
architecture_clues: Dual-layer rollout combined company-wide ChatGPT access with deeper Codex integration for builder roles
Codex was selected after a three-month evaluation across teams
Cross-functional AI Champions network translated central guidance into team-level use cases
Adoption focused on embedding AI into existing workflows rather than treating it as a standalone tool
